profiles.notes: Checked 2026-11-09. Workers Free: 100,000 requests per day (Error 1027 after that), 10 ms CPU per request. Durable Objects on Free are SQLite-backed only (this component's wrangler.jsonc uses new_sqlite_classes) with 5 GB total storage per account (https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/platform/limits/). The pages give no concurrent-connection limit, so concurrentPeople is omitted; the page does not say how incoming WebSocket messages count against the daily request limit, so requestsPerDay may overstate capacity for live-connection use. One Durable Object has a soft limit of 1,000 requests per second.

Checked 2026-11-09. Workers Paid: no request limit, 5 minutes maximum CPU per request (30 seconds default), unlimited Durable Object storage per account and 10 GB per Durable Object (https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/platform/limits/). Prices were not on the fetched limits pages, so no cost figure is recorded here; usage is billed by metering.

notes: Local checks need no account. Deployment needs a Cloudflare account supplied by reference. Limits above come only from the two Cloudflare pages named in the profile notes. The own-hardware profile has no provider limits page; limitsSource is null.
